title: Shallow targets under deep logistic and softplus posteriors
build: ./build.sh; two pdflatex passes per manuscript with halt-on-error
visual_inspection: Both packaged first pages rendered and inspected; authors, abstracts, model, equations and theorem statements are legible.

logistic.title: Shallow targets under deep logistic posteriors
logistic.source_provenance: Packaged source differs from current scratch only by correct author line. Relative to the original audited source, abstract additionally states L-1>=log T and +1 in the asymptotic energy phrase. Main theorem and proof unchanged.

softplus.title: A positive-channel wire for deep softplus posteriors
softplus.source_provenance: Exact independently audited scratch source, including correct author line.

proof_status: Independent full-manuscript PASS audits for both papers and separate derivation audits. Conventional mathematical review, not Lean verification.
scope: Actual Gaussian posterior with all-cube absolute margin and exact labels. Shallow bounded-weight teacher. Logistic polynomial samples at every depth/eligible width; softplus quasipolynomial samples above stated squared-logarithm depth threshold. Fixed-architecture cold limits and every fixed exponent gamma>1; no uniformity as gamma tends to1.
mathematical_dependencies: Logistic includes its all-layer Lipschitz representation cover, scalar transmission, finite-width Gaussian neighborhood/net, and statistical conversion. Both use standard Gaussian isoperimetry. Softplus imports only the general representation cover from the packaged logistic companion and supplies its transmission, stability and posterior transfer.
open_question: Critical gamma=1, fixed positive canonical prefactors, arbitrary deep teachers, and the original exact-tanh depth problem are not resolved.
lean_status: No theorem in this package is Lean verified.
